failure_description: Model achieved 99% accuracy on validation set but only 62% on holdout test data. Performance collapsed when deployed to production.
root_cause: Severe overfitting: 50M parameter transformer trained on 10K samples without regularization. Model memorized training patterns.
solution: Added dropout (0.3), weight decay, early stopping, and reduced model size. Augmented dataset to 100K samples. Achieved 78% on test.

failure_description: Training loss became NaN after 3 epochs. Logs showed gradient norms spiking from 0.5 to 1e8.
root_cause: Exploding gradients in LSTM layers due to unbounded activation and learning rate 0.1. Recurrent connections amplified errors.
solution: Applied gradient clipping (max_norm=1.0), reduced learning rate to 1e-3, switched to tanh activations. Training stabilized.

failure_description: Production model scored 0.45 AUC vs 0.89 AUC during validation. Feature distributions differed significantly between environments.
root_cause: Data leakage: min-max scaler fit on full dataset before train/test split. Test set statistics leaked into training preprocessing.
solution: Fit scaler only on training fold. Used sklearn Pipeline with fit_transform restricted to train. Retrained from scratch.

failure_description: Binary classifier predicted positive for 98% of samples. Precision and recall near zero despite 98% accuracy.
root_cause: Class imbalance: 98:2 ratio (fraud:legit). Model learned to always predict majority class. Accuracy metric hid the failure.
solution: Used SMOTE oversampling, class weights (inverse frequency), and switched to PR-AUC as primary metric. F1 improved to 0.72.

failure_description: Deep network layers showed near-zero weight updates. Gradients diminished to 1e-7 by layer 3 in 8-layer MLP.
root_cause: Vanishing gradients from sigmoid activations in deep feedforward net. Chain rule multiplication eroded signal.
solution: Replaced sigmoid with ReLU, added batch normalization, used Xavier initialization. Gradient flow restored.

failure_description: Model failed on images with different lighting. Train accuracy 94%, real-world deployment 51%.
root_cause: Poor preprocessing: raw pixel values, no normalization. Training data collected under controlled lab lighting only.
solution: Added histogram equalization, per-image standardization, and augmented with brightness/contrast variations. Test accuracy 81%.

failure_description: Model assigned high confidence to nonsensical inputs. Adversarial patches caused 100% misclassification.
root_cause: Overconfident calibration: softmax outputs did not reflect true probability. Model never saw out-of-distribution examples.
solution: Applied temperature scaling, added OOD detection (Mahalanobis distance), included negative samples in training.

failure_description: Recommendation model showed runaway feedback: popular items became exponentially more recommended.
root_cause: Training on logged feedback introduced selection bias. Model reinforced existing popularity instead of discovering preferences.
solution: Implemented inverse propensity weighting, debiased offline evaluation, and exploration term in ranking. Diversity increased 40%.

failure_description: NLP model performed well on formal text but failed on slang, typos, and dialect. F1 dropped 35 points.
root_cause: Distribution mismatch: training on news/corpora only. Tokenizer and embeddings unfamiliar with informal text.
solution: Added social media and chat corpora, used byte-pair encoding, fine-tuned embeddings on target domain. F1 recovered.

failure_description: Object detector missed small objects entirely. mAP for objects <32px was 0.12 vs 0.76 for large objects.
root_cause: Scale imbalance: single-scale training, stride too coarse for small objects. Anchors biased toward large boxes.
solution: Added FPN for multi-scale detection, reduced stride in backbone, tuned anchor sizes. Small object mAP reached 0.58.

failure_description: Time series forecast was 2 weeks delayed. Model appeared to predict past values shifted forward.
root_cause: Target leakage: used future-looking features (e.g., next-month sales) that would not exist at inference time.
solution: Audited features for temporal validity. Removed leaky features, enforced strict train/inference alignment. Lag eliminated.

failure_description: Model predictions differed between CPU and GPU. Same inputs produced different outputs on different hardware.
root_cause: Non-determinism: cuDNN auto-tuner, atomic operations, and floating-point order of operations varied by device.
solution: Set CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG, cuDNN deterministic mode, and fixed random seeds. Reproducibility verified across devices.

failure_description: Cross-validation scores varied from 0.65 to 0.92. Single split gave false confidence in model quality.
root_cause: Insufficient validation: small dataset (2K samples), single random split. High variance in estimates.
solution: Switched to 10-fold stratified CV with fixed seeds. Reported mean ± std. Used nested CV for hyperparameter selection.

failure_description: Embeddings for similar items had cosine similarity 0.1. Retrieval returned irrelevant results.
root_cause: Poor contrastive training: batch size 32 too small for InfoNCE. Hard negatives dominated, positive pairs underrepresented.
solution: Increased batch size to 512, used in-batch negatives, added hard negative mining. Retrieval NDCG improved from 0.31 to 0.67.

failure_description: Model degraded 3 months after deployment. Retraining on new data made performance worse.
root_cause: Concept drift and catastrophic forgetting: fine-tuning on recent data overwrote useful representations from original training.
solution: Implemented elastic weight consolidation, maintained replay buffer of old examples, used incremental learning. Performance stabilized.
